title: 第13章 另一种成事不足败事有余第14章 有样学样
content_zh:
将张万通打晕，送回他相好的床上，陈观楼在外面转了一圈，确保安全后才回到家。
躺在床上，久久不眠。
他和万狱吏没有打过交道，甚至没说过话。但二人之间渊源颇深。死鬼老爹留下的萝卜坑，就是被万狱吏动用关系抢了去，害得他差点错失天牢铁饭碗。
万狱吏要争狱丞一职，说什么也不能让他得逞。只是，该从何下手？他一个小狱卒，根本没资格参与斗争，也没办法影响上面的决定？
难道要眼睁睁看着万狱吏得逞？
那他以后岂能有好日子过。
不过……
事情也不是没有操作的余地。
狱丞再贱，那也是官，等于进入了官员序列，虽然是最底层的。
狱吏再牛，也只是吏。从来都是流水的衙门铁打的吏。
狱吏想要跨越阶层当狱丞，不说千难万难，只能说很少，少到凤毛麟角。没有一个官员会冒着被同阶层的人鄙视唾弃的风险，提拔一个吏当官。除非遇到靠山硬，背景来历硬茬到可以不顾官场规矩的官员，才有可能打破千百年来的传统。
万狱吏想升职，必须走通上面的关系。此人的背景如果真的硬茬到可以不顾传统规矩，他也不至于做个狱吏。可见，他的背景关系并没有想象中那么厉害。他想升职，不是一件容易的事情。
其他狱吏同样有关系有背景，就比如许富贵，老油条，在天牢当差这么多年，肯定认识几个有力人物。他不一定能竞争赢万狱吏。陈观楼却相信，许富贵赢不了，但一定有办法坏了万狱吏的好事。
这是另类的成事不足败事有余。
……
次日一早，张万通自昏睡中醒来，胸口的伤痛证明一切都是真的，并非做梦。他一边愤恨咒骂，扬言要报仇。一方面心有惊恐，左思右想，他怀疑天牢有人想害他。
绑匪全程只关心是天牢内部的事情，分明是冲着最近的狱丞之争。如此想来，昨晚绑架逼问他的人，很可能就是天牢中的某人。他记得绑匪的声音，只要人还在天牢，他一定能找出这个王八蛋，将对方大卸八块。
为此，他不惜拖着病痛前往天牢当差，都没想过要请假去看大夫治伤。
进门的时候，许富贵手底下的新丁，叫陈观楼的主动跟他打招呼，怪有礼貌的一个小伙子，还没被天牢这个大染缸污染。只可惜，人太心善，竟然对犯人释放善意，蠢货。听说爱好收集武学秘籍，哼，没有武脉的人收集再多的秘籍也没鸟用。说不定还会引来大麻烦。
年轻人啊，不懂事！

下次给他点教训，叫对方知道什么叫做社会险恶。
进了天牢，遇到相熟的牌友，大家胡乱吹牛。他没怀疑这些牌友，熟得不能再熟，肯定不是牌友绑他。
其实，他已经有了怀疑的目标。他怀疑甲字号大牢的狱卒。万狱吏承诺他，事成之后让他当狱吏，管理甲字号大牢。明显触动了甲字号大牢那帮狱卒的利益。
大家都想进步，非他一个。
他想当狱吏，其他人肯定更想。
他甚至怀疑，万狱吏对别的狱卒也做出了差不多的承诺。说不定他帮万狱吏做事的消息，就是被万狱吏身边的人传出去的。否则，他一个小小的狱卒，为啥被人特意针对。
特么的。
越想越觉着是这么一回事。
张万通狠狠吐了一口，心中将甲字号大牢那帮老少爷们们都骂了个狗血淋头。一边骂，一边想办法混入是甲字号队伍中，寻找昨晚的绑匪。打牌是最好的社交方式，为此，他还偷了相好的钱，就为了能顺利实施计划。
中午吃饭的时候，卢大头跟陈观楼抱怨，“张万通那厮，越来越过分了。玩归玩，以前好歹还守在值房。今儿个，从早上起就没见人，你猜他去了哪里。他跑到甲字号大牢舔别人的屁股沟子。哼，就他，还想调入甲字号大牢当差，也不瞧瞧，他一个文盲，大字不识一个，怎么和那帮官老爷打交道。”
陈观楼心头了然一笑。他猜到张万通跑去甲字号大牢的原因，估摸对方怀疑绑匪来自于甲字号大牢。
不过他更好奇另外一件事，“什么时候狱卒当差，还要识字？”
特么的，这年头有几个读书人会跑来做狱卒啊。
也就是他，读过几年书，还乐意捧天牢这碗铁饭碗。
卢大头剔着牙，一边闲扯道：“以前，没有这个规矩，甲乙丙三个字号的狱卒都是一群不识字的大老粗，也不耽误当差。不知道是哪一年改了规矩，据说是有个落马的大官，临死前留了张要命的字条。狱卒不识字，当场毁了字条。本来这也没什么，照规矩一切有字的都得毁掉。坏就坏在，这个官员的案子后来翻案了，他留字条一事也被翻了出来。这下子，相当于捅了马蜂窝，要了命。
自那以后，进入甲字号大牢当差，都要识字。其实，按你的条件，你完全可以进入甲字号大牢。不过你是新人，不懂规矩，冒然进入甲字号大牢当差，就怕一个不小心，丢了性命。”
“大头哥说的对，我还有很多不懂的地方，还要跟着大头哥多多学习。”陈观楼适当的捧了下对方。
“哈哈哈……”这话卢大头爱听，“其实甲字号大牢也就那样，虽然待遇更高一些，但是风险也大。那些犯官，别看今日落难，说不定哪天就起复，官复原职。这差不好当啊！还不如咱们丙字号自在，不用担心得罪谁。”
“大头哥太有见地了，果然是这个理。世上就数当官的最难伺候。”陈观楼殷勤的斟茶奉承。
卢大头说起劲了，嘴上就没个把门，“没错，换我我肯定不乐意去甲字号大牢当差，给人当孙子，没劲透了。而且，这几年稷下学宫出身的官员，落马的特别多。稷下学宫你知道吧，那帮人爱抱团，很不好惹。一个个都鼻孔朝天，根本不拿我们狱卒当人。偏偏你还要小心伺候着，就怕一言不合，咔嚓一声，一剑要了我们的命，连个说理的地方都没有。你说是不是这个理？”
content_en:
After knocking Zhang Wantong unconscious and sending him back to his best friend's bed, Chen Guanlou walked around outside to make sure he was safe before returning home.
Lying in bed, staying awake for a long time.
He had never interacted with or even spoken to Wan Jailer. But there is a deep connection between the two. The carrot pit left by the dead ghost father was snatched away by Wan Prisoner using his connections, causing him to almost miss out on his iron job in Tianlao.
Thousands of jailers are vying for the post of jailer, and nothing can be done to let him succeed. But, where to start? He is a small jailer, he is not qualified to participate in the struggle, and he has no way to influence the decisions above?
Do we want to watch thousands of jailers succeed?
Then how can he have a good life in the future?
But...
It's not like there's no room for maneuver.
No matter how lowly the jailer is, he is still an official, which means he has entered the ranks of officials, even though he is at the lowest level.
No matter how awesome the jailer is, he is still just a jailer. They have always been the iron-clad officials of the running government.
If a jailer wants to transcend social strata and become a jailer, not only is it extremely difficult, it can only be said that it is very rare. No official would risk being despised and cast aside by people of the same class by promoting an official to an official position. Unless you encounter an official with a strong backing and a strong background who can disregard the rules of officialdom, it is possible to break the thousands of years of tradition.
If wardens want to be promoted, they must have connections at the top. If this person's background was really tough enough to disregard traditional rules, he wouldn't be able to become a jailer. It can be seen that his background relationship is not as powerful as imagined. He wants to be promoted, which is not an easy task.
Other jailers also have connections and backgrounds, such as Xu Fugui, an experienced veteran who has been working in Tianlao for so many years and must know several powerful people. He may not be able to compete with thousands of jailers. Chen Guanlou believed that Xu Fugui could not win, but there must be a way to ruin the good deeds of Wan Jailer.
This is a different kind of failure.
…
Early the next morning, Zhang Wantong woke up from his sleep. The pain in his chest proved that everything was real and not a dream. He cursed angrily and threatened to take revenge. On the one hand, he was frightened and thought about it. He suspected that someone in Tianlao wanted to harm him.
The kidnappers only cared about the internal affairs of Tianlao throughout the whole process, and they were clearly concerned about the recent war between prison officials. Thinking about it this way, the person who kidnapped and interrogated him last night was probably someone in the sky jail. He remembered the kidnapper's voice. As long as he was still in the prison, he would be able to find this bastard and cut him into pieces.
For this reason, he did not hesitate to go to Tianlao to work despite his illness, and never thought of asking for leave to see a doctor for treatment.
When he entered, Xu Fugui's new recruit, named Chen Guanlou, took the initiative to greet him. He was a polite young man who had not been contaminated by the big dyeing vat of Tianlao. It's a pity that people are so kind-hearted that they show kindness to prisoners, idiot. I heard that I like to collect martial arts secret books. Well, it is useless no matter how many secret books a person without martial arts background collects. It might even cause big trouble.
Young people, you are ignorant!
Next time, teach him a lesson and let him know what social evil is.
After entering the prison, I met acquaintances from poker players, and everyone started bragging. He had no doubts about these poker friends. He was extremely familiar with them. It was definitely not the poker friends who tied him up.
In fact, he already had a target of suspicion. He was suspicious of the jailer in No. A prison. Warden Wan promised him that after the incident was completed, he would be the warden and manage the No. 1 prison. It obviously touched the interests of the jailers in No. A prison.
Everyone wants to make progress, but he is not the only one.
He wanted to be a jailer, and others certainly wanted to be a jailer.
He even suspected that Warden Wan had made similar promises to other jailers. Maybe the news that he was helping Wan Jailer was spread by people around Wan Jailer. Otherwise, why would he, a little jailer, be specifically targeted?
What the hell.
The more I think about it, the more I realize this is the case.
Zhang Wantong vomited hard, and in his heart he cursed all the old and young men in No. A Prison. While scolding,Find a way to sneak into the A-number team and look for the kidnapper from last night. Playing cards is the best way to socialize. For this reason, he also stole his sweetheart's money just to implement the plan smoothly.
During lunch, Lu Datou complained to Chen Guanlou, "That guy Zhang Wantong is getting more and more exaggerated. After all, he was still on duty before. Today, he hasn't seen anyone since morning. Guess where he went. He went to the No. A prison to lick other people's butts. Well, he wants to be transferred to the No. A prison as a guard. Don't look at him. He is illiterate and can't read a single word. How can he deal with those officials?"
Chen Guanlou smiled with understanding. He guessed the reason why Zhang Wantong went to No. A Prison, and estimated that the other party suspected that the kidnapper was from No. A Prison.
But he was more curious about another thing, "When does a jailer have to be literate when he is on duty?"
What the heck, how many scholars are working as jailers these days?
That is to say, he, after studying for several years, is still willing to support the iron rice bowl of Tianlao.
Lu Datou picked his teeth and chatted: "In the past, there was no such rule. The jailers of the three names of A, B, and C were a group of illiterate old men, and they did not delay their duties. I don't know which year the rules were changed. It is said that there was a high-ranking official who was dismissed and left a piece of money before his death. The note. The jailer was illiterate and destroyed the note on the spot. It didn't matter at first. According to the rules, everything with writing had to be destroyed. The bad thing was that the officer's case was later overturned, and the fact that he left the note was found out.
From then on, anyone who entered the A-size prison as a sergeant had to be literate. In fact, depending on your conditions, you can definitely enter the A-size prison. However, you are a newcomer and do not understand the rules. If you enter the A-size prison as a guard rashly, you are afraid that you will lose your life by accident. "
"Brother Big Tou is right, I still don't understand a lot, and I still need to learn more from Brother Big Tou." Chen Guanlou praised the other party appropriately.
"Hahaha..." Lu Datou liked to hear this, "Actually, the A-class jail is just like that. Although the pay is higher, the risks are also higher. Those criminals, no matter if they are in trouble today, they may be reinstated one day and resume their duties. This is not a good job! It is not as comfortable as us in C-class prison, and we don't have to worry about offending anyone."
"Brother Big Tou is so insightful. It really is true. Officials are the most difficult to serve in the world." Chen Guanlou poured tea and flattered him diligently.
Lu Datou started talking enthusiastically, but he didn't say anything. "That's right, if it were me, I would definitely not be happy to work as a clerk in a big prison and to be someone's grandson. It's very boring. Moreover, in recent years, many officials from Jixia Academy have been dismissed. You know, Jixia Academy, that gang People like to stick together, and they are very difficult to mess with. They all have their noses in the sky, and they don’t treat us as human beings. But you still have to be careful, and you are afraid that if you disagree, you will kill us with a sword. Do you think this is reasonable? "
